text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the infirmary with Red Desire,
who got injured during training.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your trouble.
I am deeply grateful for
your prompt response.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the injury was minor and has already been treated, so let us return to training.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I am well aware of that.
However, I am a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is our fate that hardship will always lie ahead.
If I cannot overcome a trial of this measure,
how could I ever call myself a Saint?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So please believe in me.
Believe that we will overcome this without fail.
choice_data_list: No, even if it's the long way around, let's rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...So you truly do not
believe in me, do you?"
choice_data_list: No. I'm having you rest because I believe in you
No. I'm having you rest because I believe in you

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Because... you believe in me...?
Then why tell me to rest...
choice_data_list: A little rest won't close off your path.
A little rest won't close off your path.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, even if I pause here, I will certainly reach 'that place.' Is that what you are trying to say?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Ufufu, understood.
Then I shall place my trust in you as well, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Using this brief moment of rest as nourishment, I will shine even brighter as a holy maiden...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as I thought, you truly are
a person worthy of walking alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us continue our training.
Allow me to show you the full potential of a saint!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Kh, but... I am not one to succumb to this level of pain...! J-Just one more—
choice_data_list: ...Isn't admitting it's reckless also part of the trial?
...Isn't admitting something is reckless a kind of trial in itself?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: That... might be true...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. For now, I shall simply face this pain..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her pain flaring back up, Red Desire
ended up taking some time off to rest.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Hah, whew...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there's no pain even after moving this much.
It seems I have overcome this trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much
for believing in me!
choice_data_list: Still, just to be safe, let's keep things light for the rest.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us proceed carefully,
with your words as our guide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to gradually easing her body back into it,
Red Desire made a smooth and steady comeback.
